name: KEY ESG (Private Equity)
description: KEY ESG gives sustainability teams instant access to their ESG data through natural language queries. Ask questions about your emissions, energy, water, waste, and social metrics without navigating dashboards or running reports manually. Retrieve progress against targets, review action plans, check uploaded policies, and generate board-ready ESG narratives, all from within your workflow. Designed for sustainability managers and their teams, KEY ESG makes ESG data faster to access, easier to interpret, and simpler to act on.

_published_faq.name: How do I add KEY ESG (Private Equity) to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add KEY ESG (Private Equity) to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.keyesg.com/pe/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the KEY ESG (Private Equity) MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: KEY ESG (Private Equity) lists 19 MCP tools, including get_metric_breakdown, get_metric_entity_breakdown, get_metric_value, get_portfolio_metric_entity_breakdown, get_portfolio_metric_value, get_portfolio_reporting_summary, list_action_plans, list_datapoint_groups, list_entities, list_funds, list_metrics, and list_policies.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to KEY ESG (Private Equity)?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to KEY ESG (Private Equity) in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does KEY ESG (Private Equity) MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: KEY ESG (Private Equity) requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
KEY ESG (Private Equity) is developed by KEY ESG. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
